description_sq:

📞 Për më shumë informacion ose për të organizuar një vizitë në pronë, ju ftojmë të kontaktoni!
description_en: 🏡 2+1+2 apartment for sale in the area of Astir, near the "Nela 5" complex 📐 Property details: Net area: 88.7 m² Gross area: 99.7 m² 4th residential floor Fully furnished Regular and functional floor plan 🏠 Organization: Open living room with kitchen 2 bedrooms 2 bathrooms (one with window) 2 balconies ✨ Advantages of area: It is positioned in one of the most developed areas of Astir, near the main services such as supermarkets, bars/restaurants, schools, kindergartens, pharmacies and with a quick exit to the Great Ring Road. 💡 An excellent choice for both comfortable living and long-term investment. 📞 For more information or to arrange a visit to the property, we invite you to get in touch!
